title: Missed reading alert does not trigger for xDrip Sync follower
symptom: Missed reading alert does not trigger for xDrip Sync follower. When set to trigger after 6 minutes of no readings, no alert is triggered after disabling WiFi with no sim card.
cause: The missed reading alert is not active unless there is a local sensor. There is a line in the code that creates a local sensor for a Nightscout follower if one does not exist, but there isn't one for xDrip Sync.
fix: This should be fixed now as of this release: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/releases/tag/2025.06.17
evidence_quote: I see that the missed reading alert is not active unless there is a local sensor. I see that there is a line in the code that creates a local sensor for a Nightscout follower if one does not exist. But, there isn't one for xDrip Sync.
